snippet.title: Omicrocity 2 (city builder) Trailer
snippet.description:
Omicrocity 2, a relaxing, cartoonish city builder where success is not just a gray, industrial megalopolis. Create your own hippie, robotic, supernatural, warlike, or artistic city, and discover the chaotic events that will put your city to the test.

play on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3411920/Omicrocity_2/
